verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is LiteLLM's proxy logging docs. They list "Custom Callbacks - Custom code and API endpoints" among the destinations for proxy input, output and exceptions, which implies outbound delivery of request events to a user-supplied HTTP endpoint. That is one thin mention inside a logging-destination list, not a documented webhook subscription feature. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (endpoint configuration and event-type selection), event catalog and payload schema, delivery semantics (retries, signing/verification), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
